description:
Add specific CSL variables to the 'Extra' field of three legal references in your Juris-M library to ensure correct citation formatting:

1. Locate 'The Path of the Law' (Holmes) and add: 'original-date: 1897'
2. Locate 'Constitutional Fact Review' (Monaghan) and add: 'DOI: 10.2307/1122547'
3. Locate 'The Due Process Clause and the Substantive Law of Torts' (Poe) and add: 'citation-key: poe_torts_1971'

Type these exactly as shown into the 'Extra' field for each respective item.
